context.transcript:
Hello, this is Talia Yesing calling.
I contributed some photos to a recent issue of your Nature magazine.
But when I checked my bank account, it looks like I was only paid for two photos instead of three.
Okay, let me pull up the accounting records for our freelance photographers.
Oh, we did indeed pay you the wrong amount.
I'll put in a payment request right now.
Thanks.
Could you also send me an updated record of the payment after you make the changes?
I'd really appreciate it.
Thank you.
context.transcript_translation:
您好，我是 Talia Yesing 打电话。
我为你们最近一期的《Nature》杂志贡献了一些照片。
但当我查我的银行账户时，看起来我只收到了两张照片的报酬，而不是三张。
好的，让我调出我们自由摄影师的会计记录。
哦，我们确实支付了错误的金额给您。
我现在就提交一份付款请求。
谢谢。
您能在我修改完之后，再给我发送一份更新后的付款记录吗？
我非常感激。
谢谢您。
